title: Velocity commands on cmd_vel
keywords: cmd_vel velocity command twist twiststamped teleop teleop_twist_keyboard stamped linear angular turn wrong direction not moving
text: Mobile bases take velocity commands on cmd_vel: linear.x is the forward speed in m/s, linear.y the sideways speed (holonomic bases only) and angular.z the turn rate in rad/s, positive counter-clockwise (to the left), all in the robot frame. Twist and TwistStamped are different types, and a Twist publisher never connects to a TwistStamped subscriber. teleop_twist_keyboard publishes Twist unless started with --ros-args -p stamped:=true. A robot that turns the wrong way usually has a swapped wheel or a flipped sign in its driver, not a wrong command.
